environment.description: EC2 c5.xlarge instance running identical Flask monolith with Gunicorn (4 workers, 8 threads each) behind an ALB. PostgreSQL 15 on RDS with RLS policies on the documents table. The database role app_user does NOT have BYPASSRLS. Additionally, the RDS instance has a custom parameter group with 'pgaudit.log = write' and a pg_cron job that runs every 100ms executing SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE application_name = 'app_user' AND state = 'idle in transaction' AND state_change < now() - interval '50ms'. The RDS proxy (deployed in front of the RDS instance) is configured with connection borrowing mode 'transaction' with session pinning on SET commands, meaning each SET app.current_tenant is pinned to a dedicated server-side connection for the duration of that transaction. The proxy's MaxConnectionsPercent is set to 40 and ConnectionBorrowTimeout to 5s. The RDS instance also has a BEFORE UPDATE trigger on documents that independently validates: NEW.tenant_id must equal current_setting('app.current_tenant')::int OR the calling role must be 'migration_admin' (a separate role not used by the application at runtime).

config.trigger_validation: BEFORE UPDATE validates tenant_id matches session
